highlights.title: Anthropic in Early Talks to Raise $30 Billion
highlights.description: Anthropic is in early talks with investors to raise at least $30 billion in fresh financing, according to people familiar with the matter. The Claude maker is in discussions to raise the new capital at a valuation of more than $900 billion, not including the investment, said the people. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
